derivation: from a comparative of G5092 (τιμή) and ouros (a guard);
def: properly, to protect one's honor, i.e. to avenge (inflict a penalty)

occurrences.text: And I punished them oft in every synagogue, and compelled them to blaspheme; and being exceedingly mad against them, I persecuted them even unto strange cities.
